children: Producer prices in Georgia rose 5.8% year-on-year in August 2026, accelerating from 5.1% in the previous month.
The acceleration reflected faster price growth in mining and quarrying (20.1% vs 14.4% in July).

Moreover, prices for electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply increased (2.6% vs -1.7%), while inflation for water supply, sewerage, waste management and remediation services accelerated (6.3% vs 5.7%).
Meanwhile, manufacturing inflation eased slightly (5.1% vs 5.2%).

Within manufacturing, price growth slowed for chemicals and chemical products (13.3% vs 15.4%) and basic metals (10.1% vs 11.0%), while food product inflation also eased (5.7% vs 6.6%), whereas coke and refined petroleum products accelerated (33.0% vs 6.0%).
On a monthly basis, producer prices rose 0.9% in August, following a 0.7% decline in July.

title: Georgia Producer Inflation Accelerates in August
